name: Feature request / Предложение
about: Explain a user need and a proposed improvement
title: ""
---

## User need

Describe the task you want to accomplish and the current obstacle. English and
Russian are welcome. Check existing issues before submitting a duplicate.

## Proposed improvement

Describe the desired behavior and any useful alternatives or examples.

## Context

Include relevant TV/firmware or installation constraints. Don't attach account
data, authenticated stream URLs, or credentials. Maintenance is best-effort;
submitting a request doesn't establish an implementation or response deadline.
